vision.question: You are inspecting a dusk photograph of two silhouetted people beside a pickup truck. Reply with one line of JSON and nothing else, using exactly these keys: {"readable_text_or_logos": true or false, "where": "short phrase, or empty", "overlay_graphics": true or false, "subject_visible": true or false}. readable_text_or_logos is true if any legible words, brand names, badges or logos appear anywhere. overlay_graphics is true if there are subtitles, watermarks, app interface elements or other graphics drawn over the picture. subject_visible is true if the picture clearly shows two dark human silhouettes and a pickup truck.
